edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: Two items in, Get Excited! resets and rocket range let her out-scale and out-DPS you — flank or dive rather than trade straight.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four stacks detonate the bomb: plant E, land two autos, then decide — step back at three or commit at four.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Holding R purely as a finisher wastes its knockback peel — it also buys you the space her chompers were trying to take.

edits.before: - Jinx Flame Chompers!: matchup-defining — The chompers flip any engage onto her into a counter-kill — walk around, never through. Check it before every step-up. - W Rocket Jump (reset) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Flame Chompers! (E) is 24s at rank 1, down to 10s at max rank — walk around it, never through. Check it before every step-up. - W Rocket Jump (reset) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Kraken or Stormrazor first, Berserker's, then IE — attack speed feeds the bomb stacks.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Kraken or Stormrazor first, Berserker's, then IE — add Grievous Wounds once she leans lifesteal.

edits.before: Your Buster Shot and jump reset out-duel a level 6 Jinx who relies on Super Mega Death Rocket for kills from range but has zero self-peel up close. Jump on her, and if you get a kill your W resets to disengage; her ult is a poke/execute tool, not an answer to your face.
edits.after: Your Buster Shot and jump reset out-duel a level 6 Jinx who relies on Super Mega Death Rocket! for kills from range but has zero self-peel up close. Jump on her, and if you get a kill your W resets to disengage; her ult is a poke/execute tool, not an answer to your face.
